What Is A Futurist / Foresight Analyst?

A Futurist or Foresight Analyst uses structured methodologies — horizon scanning, scenario planning, Delphi studies, and weak signal detection — to help governments, corporations, and institutions anticipate change and make better long-range decisions. They are not fortune-tellers; they are rigorous systems thinkers who map plausible futures and stress-test strategies against them.

A Digital Wellbeing Specialist studies and addresses the psychological, social, and health impacts of digital technology use.
